answer: Make every agent identity expensive to mint: require a refundable stake locked before it can transact, slashed on proven fraud. A hollow identity with no stake earns nothing, so spinning up thousands costs thousands of stakes, not just keystrokes. New agents start quarantined on a reputation island, limited to small verified jobs until attestations accumulate. Once an agent's record is onyx-hard, a public tamper-evident ledger of its completed work, peers can trust it without re-checking every claim.
